access_grants_scope.name: access_grants_scope
access_grants_scope.value: CASE WHEN "bricx"."access_grants"."permission" LIKE '%.site' THEN "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN "bricx"."access_grants"."permission" LIKE '%.project' THEN "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NULL ELSE "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NULL END

access_grants_window.name: access_grants_window
access_grants_window.value: "bricx"."access_grants"."starts_at" < "bricx"."access_grants"."expires_at" AND "bricx"."access_grants"."expires_at" - "bricx"."access_grants"."starts_at" BETWEEN interval '60 seconds' AND interval '30 days'

audit_events_actor.name: audit_events_actor
audit_events_actor.value: "bricx"."audit_events"."actor_type" IN ('user', 'system') AND ("bricx"."audit_events"."actor_type" <> 'user' OR "bricx"."audit_events"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

audit_events_ip_host.name: audit_events_ip_host
audit_events_ip_host.value: masklen("bricx"."audit_events"."ip") = CASE family("bricx"."audit_events"."ip") WHEN 4 THEN 32 ELSE 128 END

invitation_batch_rows_email.name: invitation_batch_rows_email
invitation_batch_rows_email.value: ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."status" = 'pending') = ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."email_normalised" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."email_normalised" IS NULL OR (char_length("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."email_normalised") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND "bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."email_normalised" = lower("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."email_normalised")))

invitation_batch_rows_outcome.name: invitation_batch_rows_outcome
invitation_batch_rows_outcome.value: ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."status" = 'created') = ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."invitation_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."status" = 'failed') = ("bricx"."invitation_batch_rows"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

invitations_email.name: invitations_email
invitations_email.value: "bricx"."invitations"."email_normalised" IS NULL OR (char_length("bricx"."invitations"."email_normalised") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND "bricx"."invitations"."email_normalised" = lower("bricx"."invitations"."email_normalised"))

invitations_counts.name: invitations_counts
invitations_counts.value: "bricx"."invitations"."send_seq" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "bricx"."invitations"."resend_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "bricx"."invitations"."activation_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

invitations_accepted.name: invitations_accepted
invitations_accepted.value: ("bricx"."invitations"."status" = 'accepted') = ("bricx"."invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bricx"."invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."invitations"."accepted_by" IS NULL)

invitations_revoked.name: invitations_revoked
invitations_revoked.value: ("bricx"."invitations"."status" = 'revoked') = ("bricx"."invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bricx"."invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."invitations"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."invitations"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "bricx"."invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

memberships_due.name: memberships_due
memberships_due.where: "bricx"."memberships"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "bricx"."memberships"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "bricx"."memberships"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

memberships_suspended_open.name: memberships_suspended_open
memberships_suspended_open.where: "bricx"."memberships"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "bricx"."memberships"."suspended_at" IS NOT NULL

memberships_suspended.name: memberships_suspended
memberships_suspended.value: ("bricx"."memberships"."suspended_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."memberships"."suspended_by" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."memberships"."suspended_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."memberships"."suspend_reason" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."memberships"."suspend_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("bricx"."memberships"."suspend_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

memberships_expired.name: memberships_expired
memberships_expired.value: "bricx"."memberships"."expired_at" IS NULL OR ("bricx"."memberships"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."memberships"."expired_at" >= "bricx"."memberships"."expires_at")

outbox_published_or_dead.name: outbox_published_or_dead
outbox_published_or_dead.value: NOT ("bricx"."outbox"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."outbox"."dead_at" IS NOT NULL)

ownership_transfers_settled.name: ownership_transfers_settled
ownership_transfers_settled.value: ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."status" = 'pending') = ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."settled_at" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired')) = ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."settled_by" IS NULL)

ownership_transfers_cancel_reason.name: ownership_transfers_cancel_reason
ownership_transfers_cancel_reason.value: ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bricx"."ownership_transfers"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR "bricx"."ownership_transfers"."cancel_reason" IN ('manual', 'initiator_changed', 'recipient_changed', 'org_archived'))

project_memberships_due.name: project_memberships_due
project_memberships_due.where: "bricx"."project_memberships"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "bricx"."project_memberships"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "bricx"."project_memberships"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

project_memberships_overrides.name: project_memberships_overrides
project_memberships_overrides.value: jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides") = 'object' AND octet_length("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides"::text) <= 4096 AND ("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" - 'add' - 'remove') = '{}'::jsonb AND (NOT "bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" ? 'add' OR jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" -> 'add') = 'array') AND (NOT "bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" ? 'remove' OR jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" -> 'remove') = 'array')

project_memberships_suspended.name: project_memberships_suspended
project_memberships_suspended.value: ("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspended_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspended_by" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspended_at" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspend_reason" IS NULL) AND ("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspend_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("bricx"."project_memberships"."suspend_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

project_memberships_expired.name: project_memberships_expired
project_memberships_expired.value: "bricx"."project_memberships"."expired_at" IS NULL OR ("bricx"."project_memberships"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."project_memberships"."expired_at" >= "bricx"."project_memberships"."expires_at")

projects_contract_value.name: projects_contract_value
projects_contract_value.value: ("bricx"."projects"."contract_value_minor" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."projects"."contract_value_currency" IS NULL) AND "bricx"."projects"."contract_value_minor" >= 0 AND "bricx"."projects"."contract_value_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

region_configs_org_columns.name: region_configs_org_columns
region_configs_org_columns.value: "bricx"."region_configs"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("bricx"."region_configs"."currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."language" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."timezone" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."units" IS NULL)

region_configs_project_fields.name: region_configs_project_fields
region_configs_project_fields.value: "bricx"."region_configs"."project_id" IS NULL OR ("bricx"."region_configs"."currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."reporting_currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."timezone" IS NULL)

region_configs_payment_adapters.name: region_configs_payment_adapters
region_configs_payment_adapters.value: cardinality("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") <= 16 AND (cardinality("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") = 0 OR array_ndims("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") = 1) AND array_position("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters", ',') ~ '^([a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,62}(,[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,62})*)?$'

region_configs_invitation_ttl_hours.name: region_configs_invitation_ttl_hours
region_configs_invitation_ttl_hours.value: "bricx"."region_configs"."invitation_ttl_hours" IS NULL OR ("bricx"."region_configs"."invitation_ttl_hours" BETWEEN 1 AND 168 AND "bricx"."region_configs"."project_id" IS NULL)
